record_type: RASPA reference simulation structure of a real published MOF; not claimed to be an experimental CIF deposition

license.scope_evidence: RASPA2 repository COPYING; no per-structure license exception identified

publication_cited_in_cif.authors: M. Eddaoudi, J. Kim, N. Rosi, D. Vodak, J. Wachter, M. O'Keeffe, O. M. Yaghi
publication_cited_in_cif.title: Systematic design of pore size and functionality in isoreticular MOFs and their application in methane storage

independent_pre_import_crosscheck.ase_warning: ASE warns it does not interpret the cubic crystal-system label; the explicit operators expand to the same 424 coordinates as Gemmi.

preprocessing_policy.solvent: Source contains only framework Zn/O/C/H; no solvent deletion is applied.
preprocessing_policy.hydrogen: All source hydrogen atoms are retained; none are added or relaxed.
preprocessing_policy.occupancy: Source has no occupancy column; use crystallographic default occupancy 1, rejecting partial sites if later substituted.
preprocessing_policy.disorder: No source disorder groups or alternative positions are declared; no disorder reconstruction is inferred.
preprocessing_policy.charges: Source atom charges are zero; scattering uses neutral IT92 form factors, not force-field charges.
preprocessing_policy.thermal_motion: Source has no ADPs; current examples use fixed atoms and no thermal attenuation.
preprocessing_policy.optimization: No optimization method or experimental specimen identity is established by this source.
preprocessing_policy.surfaces: Default finite examples keep complete conventionally wrapped cells; pxrd_atom_cut.json additionally intersects one cell with the declared sphere. No surface passivation, bond completion, or relaxation is performed.
preprocessing_policy.pores_and_guests: Omitted. This source does not supply validated nanoparticle pore sites, template populations, or experimental guest statistics.

upstream_caveat: RASPA marks structure, molecule and force-field inputs as software examples requiring validation for new systems.

atom_cut_expectations.check_method: Euclidean radius selection on independently symmetry-expanded and modulo-one-wrapped conventional-cell coordinates.
